description: Count the Loading Bay stock, then walk the Rust Quarter cache and tally how much has walked off on its own. 10₵.
name: Shrinkage Count

objectives.desc: Count stock at the Loading Bay
emotes: {who} taps each crate at the Loading Bay, counting under their breath, and loses track twice.
{who} paces the Loading Bay, tallying crates on their fingers.
{who} circles a stack of pallets, recounting for the third time.
{who} pokes through the Rust Quarter cache, tallying like their life depends on getting the same number twice.
{who} digs through scrap at the cache, muttering a running total.
{who} eyeballs the pile and rounds the number up, generously.
